verdict.rationale: The REST API and PATs/internal connections let scripts read/create/update many pages or database rows programmatically (notion-docs-1, notion-docs-2, notion-docs-9), which supports building bulk operations via automation, but there is no documented native batch/bulk endpoint, rate-limit-aware batching, or first-party bulk-edit tooling in the evidence. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API endpoints or rate-limit guidance, hands-on/community confirmation that large-scale bulk operations work reliably, and any first-party bulk-edit UI or tool.
